title: Finite subcategory scalar mate maps
statement: The finite-subcategory comparison isomorphisms q and b exist with their normalization, counit equation, and shift compatibilities for every finite coefficient map and every pair of finite operation packages.

proof.text: Construct the proper/open scalar comparison and transport it through the full finite-Tor subcategories; record its normalization, counit equation, and shifts.
